description: Mark webhook events as processed so they won't appear again. Pass event_ids to clear a whole batch in one call (preferred when several events were handled together); event_id marks a single event.

event_id.description: A single event ID to mark as processed

event_ids.description: Event IDs to mark as processed in one call (1-100). Returns a per-id success/failure verdict; ids that succeed stay marked even if others fail.

name: mark_processed
title: Mark Events Processed
